name: Integration - Configuration Loading from Environment
description: Verifies that the agent loads configuration from environment variables and initializes the LLM client accordingly.
input: Set environment variables for LLM_PROVIDER, LLM_MODEL, LLM_TEMPERATURE, LLM_MAX_TOKENS, and OPENAI_API_KEY.
output: AgentConfig instance with values matching the environment variables and a properly initialized LLM client.
success_criteria: LLM client is initialized without error
